notes: What a scanned rock is worth. Scan or paste a rock scan and Mavin works out what is in it: per mineral, how much you should pull out in SCU, what that refines down to, and roughly what it sells for - in that order, because the first is arithmetic on your own scan and the other two are estimates built on it. It reads the COMPOSITION total off your screenshot for you. It uses your refinery and sell location from Preferences when you have set them, and says on the card which it used; with nothing set up you still get numbers, using Ferron Exchange and the most profitable terminal for that ore, both labelled as defaults. Inert material is excluded and shown as a percentage, so the ore total is lower than the COMPOSITION figure on the scan. Quality is shown per line but does not change the price - refining goes by amount. Also fixed: pasting a screenshot with Ctrl+V now goes through the same path as picking a file, so it no longer fails where the file picker worked, and import errors say which thing actually went wrong instead of blaming your photo.
